info.title: Research Gap Discovery Engine API
info.description: API for extracting research parameters and discovering gaps

post.description:
SSE endpoint for arXiv-based research extraction.

Rate limited hard: one call fans out to dozens of arXiv downloads and a
long chain of LLM requests.

This endpoint:
1. Takes a user's research prompt (and optional topics) and generates topics via LLM when needed
2. Searches arXiv for papers on each topic
3. Downloads, extracts, and processes papers through the extraction pipeline
4. Generates trend analysis and visualization data
5. Streams progress updates via SSE

The final COMPLETED message includes a 'trends' key with all visualization data
ready for MUI X Charts in the React frontend.

The run executes as a background job, so losing this connection stops the
streaming, not the work. Every event carries a `job_id` and `sequence`;
reconnect at GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/events?after={sequence} to pick up
where it left off.

get.description:
Current status of a research job.

Lets a client that lost its stream find out whether the run is still going
before deciding to resume.

LLM usage for a research job: tokens, latency, throughput, cost.

Broken down by pipeline stage and by model, so the slow stage and the
expensive model are both visible. Readable while the job is running.
Costs are estimates at list prices; see `prices_checked` for their date.

Resume a job's SSE stream.

Args:
    after: last sequence number already received. The default replays the
        run from the beginning, so a client that missed everything still
        gets the full picture.

post.description:
SSE endpoint for comprehensive literature review generation.

This endpoint streams real-time progress updates as it:
1. Loads base papers from the saved processed dataset
2. Searches arXiv for additional papers with diverse strategies (date, relevance, updates)
3. Downloads and extracts text from PDFs with smart sectioning (first/last pages)
4. Creates text chunks with priority weighting for key sections
5. Selects most relevant chunks using weighted semantic similarity
6. Generates LaTeX review using LLM
7. Saves review and metadata

Request body:
- saved_filepath: Path to the processed papers JSON file
- paper_index: Index of the paper in the processed dataset
- paper_info: Dictionary containing paper metadata (title, keywords, abstract, topic)

The final COMPLETED message includes:
- LaTeX review content
- Bibliography with all cited papers
- Metadata about the review generation process
- Statistics on papers and chunks processed

get.description:
Retrieve a specific review by ID.

Args:
    review_id: Unique identifier for the review (timestamp)

Returns:
    Review data including LaTeX content and metadata

List all reviews, optionally filtered by source dataset.

Query Parameters:
    saved_filepath: Optional filter by source dataset filepath

Returns:
    List of review metadata dictionaries

post.description:
Compile LaTeX text to PDF and return the PDF file.

Compilation is sandboxed — see `utils.latex` for what that covers.

Request Body:
    latex_text: Raw LaTeX content to compile

Returns:
    PDF file

Status codes:
    400: the document could not be compiled
    503: no TeX toolchain is installed on this server

get.description:
Endpoint to retrieve the reference graph for a given project ID.
Returns nodes and edges as stored in the graph (including authors).

Whether a project's papers can be searched with the configured model.

A project indexed under a different embedding model is not searchable
until it is re-indexed: vectors from two models are not comparable.

Passages from a project's papers, best first, with no LLM involved.

Status codes:
    404: no such project
    409: the project has no passages for the configured embedding model

post.description:
Answer a question from a project's papers, citing the passages used.

The answer cites sources inline as [S1], [S2]; `sources` maps each id to
its passage. Citations of sources the model was never shown are removed
and listed in `dropped_citations`. `grounded` is false when the answer
neither cites a source nor declines — return it to a user with a warning,
or not at all.

Status codes:
    404: no such project
    409: the project has no passages for the configured embedding model
    502: the language model provider failed

Ask the research assistant a question about a project (SSE).

A supervisor delegates to specialists — literature, research gaps,
citations — that use the project's tools; a writer answers from what they
found, citing evidence as [E1], [E2]; a critic checks the answer against
that evidence and may send it back once. Every step streams as it
happens. The final event carries the answer, its citations, the plan and
the critique.

Pass `thread_id` to continue a conversation; follow-up questions see the
recent history.

Status codes:
    404: no such project, or no such thread in it
    409: the project has no indexed passages

get.description: A project's assistant conversations, most recently active first.
One conversation, every message in order, answers with their evidence.
